summary: The filing is a Form 6-K submitted by Sprott Physical Platinum & Palladium Trust, a closed-end mutual fund trust, containing its interim management report of fund performance and unaudited interim financial statements for the period ended March 31, 2026. The report discusses investment objectives, risks, and operational results, including unrealized losses on precious metals. No transaction, corporate action, or event qualifying as a special situation is described. The filing is a routine periodic financial report, not a special-situation trigger.
